candidate: H3 = expanding mean of mature 20-session labels conditioned on the frozen volatility state (state-vol-v1 EWMA forecast above or below the frozen calibration reference variance) observed at the label's own decision
selection_rationale: The only module in today's ladder with a verified score improvement is the volatility state (EWMA QLIKE lower than the constant reference in 10 of 12 years). Every return-conditioning variable tried so far (MA200 regime at 1 and 20 sessions, sign of the last return) did not beat the expanding mean. The volatility state is the one causal, frozen, independently verified feature not yet tested as a conditioning variable for expected return.

The question it answers is narrow and pre-specified: does the 20-session mean price return differ between high- and low-volatility states as defined before any outcome was seen? Allocation v1 already changed exposure by this state and lowered drawdown with lower terminal PnL; whether the conditional mean itself differs is the missing descriptive fact behind that result.
It adds exactly one element to the frozen H1 baseline with the same estimator family as H2 (two-cell conditional expanding mean), so the comparison isolates the conditioning variable.
The state enters only as an ordinal cell (above/below a fixed threshold), so the series/unit mismatch bill flagged for mean-variance combination does not arise; no h value is used as a magnitude.

Alternatives considered and not selected now: (a) a no-trade band for allocation v1 (costs were about 2% of the PnL difference, so the band cannot change the conclusion); (b) heterogeneous-agent b>0 mechanism study (F2) (mechanism, not a prediction or ledger question); (c) stopping the prediction axis and reporting to the owner (can follow this rung either way).

volatility_state_feature.h_t: EWMA conditional second moment of the adjusted close-to-close log return for session t+1, formed at close t: h_initial = mean of the first 252 calibration r^2, then h_{t+1} = 0.94 h_t + 0.06 r_t^2 recursively over the adjusted return series; this reproduces the frozen state recursion exactly (same float expression order), it is not a new estimate
volatility_state_feature.why_recompute: the stored forecast_records cover decisions from 2014-12-30 only, while pooled labels start at index 199 (2003-08-01); the recursion is deterministic given the frozen spec, so warm-up values are reproduced and the 2,906 stored forecasts serve as an exact alignment anchor (every recomputed h for a stored decision must equal the stored value bit-for-bit or within 1e-18)
volatility_state_feature.threshold: h_ref = constant_calibration_second_moment = mean of calibration r^2 through 2014-12-31 (2.1990e-04 per the state envelope), frozen before any outcome; v_t = 1 if h_t > h_ref else 0; equality -> 0
volatility_state_feature.availability: h_t uses adjusted closes through t only; v_t is defined for every t >= 199 because the EWMA starts in 2003 after 252 calibration returns (first return index 1, so h is defined from index 252 onward; indices 199..251 fall inside the initial 252-return window and would be undefined) - see open_point_1
volatility_state_feature.open_point_1: pool start 199 precedes the first defined EWMA value (index 252). Options: (A) keep pool start 199 for the global/H1 pool and assign labels with j < 252 to a third 'undefined' cell that is never selected (counted and reported); (B) move the pool start for ALL variants to 252 and re-derive the calendar facts (breaks exact reuse of stored H1 pool counts). dobby recommends (A): H1 pool and alignment stay byte-identical, only 53 labels sit in the undefined cell

new_predictor.name: H3_volstate_conditional_mean
new_predictor.formula: at grid decision i: mean of mature labels Y_j with v_j == v_i (cells 0/1); labels with undefined v_j (j < 252) are in cell 'undefined', counted, never selected
new_predictor.attribution: each matured label j is added at close i = j + 21 to the global accumulator and to cell v_j (its own decision's state), never to the current state
new_predictor.fallback: empty selected cell -> contemporaneous global mean (must equal stored H1 within 1e-15), counted; empty global -> 0, counted
new_predictor.invariants: n_cell0 + n_cell1 + n_undefined == n_global; n_selected == n_cell[v_i]; empty cell mean null
